arguments.prompt: Medium shot beside the left end of a long finished timber stage. A workman in a high-visibility vest, seen in profile, puts his weight on the first tread of a short flight of new pine steps set against the platform, bounces once to test it, nods to himself, steps down and walks out of frame to the left at an ordinary pace. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. The row of folding chairs and the podium on the platform stay perfectly still; behind them City Hall with its mauve banner; parked cars do not move; the lumber truck and box van stand at the kerb; steam from a hot-food cart; a bus stopped at the far corner. Low afternoon winter sun, long shadows. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: single-source natural light, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
